name: Bregorra
summary: Bregorra pairs the richness of half leather with a sleek silhouette, creating a design that feels both tactile and refined. Its matte black legs ground the form with quiet strength, offering a subtle contrast that enhances the elegance of the leather surface. Minimal in detail yet assured in presence, it reflects a contemporary approach to timeless luxury. 219x200x91(180×200)
